title: Dancing in the Square
notes: At noon a troupe of women dance in step on a sunlit plaza, arms raised together, their shadows stretched across the paving: guangchangwu, China's square dancing.
location: Xin'ao Shopping Center, Olympic Park, Beijing
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: A dozen women in red dresses, flowered skirts, trench coats and plaid shirts stand in loose rows on a sunny paved plaza, each raising one arm overhead in the same dance move, with trees and a grey building behind.
caption: Dancing in the Square
